narrative.structure: grief drama mutating into occult horror

analysis.themes: A family tragedy becomes an excavation of grief and inherited damage — the occult plot literalizes the idea that some things are passed down whether you want them or not.
analysis.atmosphere: Suffocating dread that grows out of real emotional devastation; the horror works because the family pain underneath it is genuine.
analysis.narrative: Begins as an unflinching grief drama, then slowly reveals its architecture as something older and designed — the family was never in control.
analysis.visual: Miniature-model compositions and dollhouse framing make the house itself feel like a diorama the family is trapped inside.
analysis.characters: Annie's breakdown anchors the film; each family member carries grief differently, which the cult design exploits.
